import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json
def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    prod = app.activeProduct
    des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(prod)
    out = {'document': doc.name if doc else None, 'product': prod.productType if prod else None}
    if des:
        root = des.rootComponent
        out['root'] = root.name
        out['rootBodies'] = [b.name for b in root.bRepBodies]
        out['sketches'] = [{'name':s.name, 'profiles':s.profiles.count, 'bbox':[[s.boundingBox.minPoint.x,s.boundingBox.minPoint.y],[s.boundingBox.maxPoint.x,s.boundingBox.maxPoint.y]]} for s in root.sketches]
        out['occurrences'] = [o.name for o in root.allOccurrences]
        out['occurrenceBodies'] = {o.name:[b.name for b in o.bRepBodies] for o in root.allOccurrences}
    print(json.dumps(out))
